# From Home to Rome

> > Your insider guide to Rome's hidden gems, vacation rentals, and local experiences beyond the typical tourist trail.

From Home to Rome (FHTR) is a Rome-focused travel and accommodation platform offering curated vacation rentals in neighborhoods like Trastevere, along with insider guides to off-the-beaten-path attractions, local events, modern architecture, and authentic Roman experiences. The site combines property listings with cultural content about Rome's lesser-known landmarks, seasonal festivals, and neighborhood discoveries.

## Key Topics

- Trastevere neighborhood
- Rome vacation rentals
- Off-the-beaten-path attractions
- Rome landmarks and piazzas
- Aventine Hill
- Circus Maximus area
- Rome events and festivals
- Walking tours
- Palazzo Venezia and Piazza Venezia
- Santa Maria in Trastevere
- EUR modern architecture
- Janiculum Hill views
- Local Rome experiences
- Seasonal Rome activities

## Hidden Rome: Off-the-Beaten-Path Attractions

- [Unknown Rome: Villa Lante and its stunning views](https://www.fromhometorome.com/unknown-rome-villa-lante-and-its-stunning-views): Villa Lante on Janiculum Hill offers panoramic views over Trastevere
- [Aventine Hill: more to see beyond Giardino degli Aranci](https://www.fromhometorome.com/aventine-hill-more-to-see-beyond-giardino-degli-aranci): Explore Aventine Hill's churches and gardens beyond Orange Garden
- [Rome's Rose Garden: a romantic's paradise by the Circus Maximus](https://www.fromhometorome.com/romes-rose-garden-a-romantics-paradise-by-the-circus-maximus): Roseto Comunale rose garden on Aventine Hill near Circus Maximus
- [House of the Knights of Rhodes](https://www.fromhometorome.com/house-of-the-knights-of-rhodes): Medieval Knights of Rhodes building near Forum of Augustus
- [Alla scoperta delle case tematiche di Roma](https://www.fromhometorome.com/alla-scoperta-delle-case-tematiche-di-roma): Discover Rome's themed cultural houses and alternative museums
- [A different Rome: modern architecture in the city](https://www.fromhometorome.com/a-different-rome-modern-architecture-in-the-city): Guide to Rome's modern rationalist and brutalist architecture in EUR

## Rome Events & Seasonal Activities

- [Summer festivals in Rome: what's on and what's hot!](https://www.fromhometorome.com/summer-festivals-in-rome-whats-on-and-whats-hot): Guide to Estate Romana summer festivals and concerts at Circus Maximus
- [June 2: Republic Day Celebrations in Rome](https://www.fromhometorome.com/june-2-republic-day-celebrations-in-rome): Festa della Repubblica celebrations with military parade & Frecce Tricolori
- [The FEI World Championships are back in Rome!](https://www.fromhometorome.com/the-fei-world-championships-are-back-in-rome): FEI equestrian championships at Pratoni del Vivaro, Castelli Romani
- [Six Nations returns to Rome: the best pubs/sports bars in the city!](https://www.fromhometorome.com/six-nations-returns-to-rome-the-best-pubs-sports-bars-in-the-city): Best Rome pubs and sports bars to watch Six Nations rugby
